quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (April-September 2025) consolidated results: revenue fell 4.6% year on year, core operating income (business profit) fell 14.2%, operating income fell 19.1% and interim net income attributable to owners of the parent fell 33.5%. Group R&D expense for the half was JPY 360 hundred million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue JPY 12,343 hundred million (-4.6%); core operating income JPY 679 hundred million (-14.2%); operating income JPY 643 hundred million (-19.1%); net income attributable JPY 369 hundred million (-33.5%)

quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 segments (management analysis): Performance Chemicals revenue fell 7.2% and core operating income 15.3% - the film business saw growing demand for electronic components but sluggish battery separator film sales, and electronic & information materials were hit by weak panel demand and intensified competition in China for OLED-related and circuit materials. Carbon Fiber Composite Materials revenue fell 11.4% and core operating income 19.6%: aerospace end demand was recovering, but supply-chain inventory adjustment and the stronger yen weighed, and pressure vessel applications were in adjustment. Environment & Engineering core operating income fell 16.8% as large Middle East water treatment shipments had been concentrated in the prior year and the Chinese market was weak.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 segment revenue / core operating income (JPY hundred million): Fibers & Textiles 5,040 / 350; Performance Chemicals 4,433 / 288; Carbon Fiber Composite Materials 1,354 / 94; Environment & Engineering 1,170 / 98; Life Science 251 / -11
